uncertainties.note: Speaker of the 'father' lines is Sakomizu's daughter (Luxe Sakomizu, per character_names_021.json), confirmed by his reply at dialogue_06451 ('you are my own daughter'). Whether every later interjection in the argument (through dialogue_06475/06476/06477 in the next batch) is Luxe again, or a different ally speaking, is not settled by context; no identity or gender was invented beyond what the dialogue itself confirms.

King Sakomizu addresses 'Suzuki-kun' directly at dialogue_06461, confirming the reply at dialogue_06462 is Asap Suzuki (masculine self-reference 'boku-tachi' in source, consistent with his locked male gender); dialogue_06463 then names 'Asap' explicitly, confirming the attribution.

'Guld' is the researched en_short for Guld Goa Bowman in character_names_021.json (high confidence) but is not yet promoted into glossary.json. Identified as the speaker being praised for dialogue_06468-06469 by this direct address; used as given by the research file per task instructions.
Source says only 'Nadesico', untagged; which hull (the original ship or the Nadesico B in current service) is meant is not specified here and was not guessed.

'阻止限界点' (lit. 'interception limit point') rendered as 'the point of no return' as the closest natural English idiom for a deadline past which the falling colony can no longer be stopped; no additional facts supplied.

validation.self_check: All angle-bracket commands verified to match the source in the same order for every row (op/on, sp(20), ab(n), ed(), off(), color/ce, book/endbook where present); no malformed tags encountered in this slice. No newline characters were added beyond those present in the source at matching clause breaks. Every id from dialogue_06396 to dialogue_06475 is present exactly once.
validation.fit: All rows fit within the 110-character visible-text budget; longest rows are dialogue_06400, dialogue_06433 and dialogue_06445 (all under 100 characters). No row was shortened at the cost of dropping meaning.
validation.glyphs: No lowercase j or q left outside locked terms/names (Boson Jump, Jamil, Bright is unaffected). Straight quotes and ASCII-only punctuation used throughout (e.g. dialogue_06475's quoted 'guiding').
validation.meaning_review: Independently meaning-reviewed against the Japanese source (see review_06396.json). 79 of 80 rows needed no change; dialogue_06433 was reworded ('fall trajectory' -> 'collision course') to remove a stray lowercase j from a non-locked word per the glyph rule. All rows set to meaning_reviewed; none left as draft.
